text: APPROVE. Replacing the `string.IsNullOrEmpty(parent) || string.Equals(...)` check with a helper call removes the `||` sequence from the loop, which should bring the complexity from 16 to 15. The new `TryGetParent(dir, out dir)` call keeps the same behaviour: the by-value argument is copied before the `out` assignment, `dir` is left unchanged on failure, and the loop breaks either way. It should still build, since the `IsNullOrEmpty` check makes `candidate` non-null for the nullable analysis. The one thing I couldn't confirm from the diff alone is that `CHA0004` doesn't fire on `Path.GetDirectoryName` now that it sits outside the `#pragma` region.
